name: Session Capture Hook
description: A session hook for Claude Code and Codex that captures one summary thought per episode of a session into Open Brain — a piece of work, cut at compactions, moves to another branch or checkout, and new tickets — at each compaction and at session end: what was asked, what came out, what changed, with the thoughts that piece retrieved as its provenance, through a capture-only key, after a secret scan that blanks a single-line secret and refuses a multi-line key blob. The summary is derived by default; an opt-in `summary: "model"` has a local model — through the egress gate — rewrite it into what was decided, falling back to the derived text. Off until you paste the hooks it prints.
